description: Aplikasi monitoring jaringan FTTH (Fiber to the Home) & visual traceroute tool siap-pakai untuk Ubuntu 24.04 LXC. Dirancang dengan presisi telekomunikasi, dark mode command-center berdensitas tinggi, kartu status real-time, visualisasi hop traceroute, serta inventaris ONU/ONT/Router.
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Command-Center Precision & Network NOC)

entry_surfaces./login: split branded NOC auth — left branding telemetry panel with live ping animation preview, right compact credentials card
entry_surfaces./: command-center dashboard — top telemetry KPI bar, active alerts ribbon, latency chart, and dense FTTH device status table

layout_and_grids.structure: Sidebar + Fixed Command Bar Header + Dense Scrollable NOC Viewport
layout_and_grids.details_split: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 with 8 cols for charts and 4 cols for specs & telemetry logs
layout_and_grids.traceroute_layout: Top input command bar (host + max hops + timeout) -> Split view: Visual Node-Hop Flow Diagram (left/top) + Raw Terminal Log (right/bottom)

key_features_and_views.name: Masuk / Setup Awal Admin
key_features_and_views.description: Layar autentikasi dengan deteksi first-run setup admin jika database masih kosong.

key_features_and_views.name: NOC Dashboard FTTH
key_features_and_views.description: Ringkasan metrik (Total Perangkat, Online/Up, Offline/Down, Rata-rata Latensi, Loss Rate), filter cepat (Semua, OLT, ONT/ONU, Router, Server), tabel status dengan toggle auto-refresh 5s/15s/30s/manual ping.

key_features_and_views.name: Inventaris Perangkat FTTH
key_features_and_views.description: Manajemen CRUD perangkat (Nama, Host/IP, Tipe: OLT/ONU/ONT/Router/Switch/Server, Lokasi/ODC/ODP, No. Port/PON, Deskripsi, Interval Ping). Fitur Export/Import JSON/CSV.

key_features_and_views.name: Detail Perangkat & Riwayat Ping
key_features_and_views.description: Grafik latensi time-series (Recharts), metrik uptime persentase 24 jam / 7 hari, log ping terakhir, dan tombol 'Ping Sekarang'.

key_features_and_views.name: Visual Traceroute Tool
key_features_and_views.description: Tool eksekusi real traceroute berbasis backend LXC Ubuntu dengan visualisasi hop-by-hop grafis interaktif (IP, latency ms, DNS PTR, jitter, loss) + salin hasil teks mentah.

key_features_and_views.name: Pengaturan Sistem & Ping Worker
key_features_and_views.description: Konfigurasi interval background ping loop, threshold warning latensi (ms), timeout ping, ganti password admin, informasi environment LXC.

motion_and_interactions.refresh_pulse: Subtle green/blue ping beacon indicator when periodic polling happens
motion_and_interactions.traceroute_hops: Staggered fade-and-slide hop cards revealing sequentially as traceroute processes
motion_and_interactions.chart_tooltips: Cursor snap with dark slate tooltip box and monospace coordinate labels

accessibility.wcag_level: WCAG AA (4.5:1 text contrast on dark backgrounds)
accessibility.data_testids: All interactive inputs, buttons, status indicators, and modals have kebab-case data-testid attributes
accessibility.screen_readers: Aria labels for icon-only action buttons (e.g. Ping Sekarang, Hapus Perangkat, Edit)

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Konfigurasi CSS di `frontend/src/index.css` dengan font Outfit (headings), IBM Plex Sans (body), dan JetBrains Mono (data/IP/latensi).
2. Gunakan tema gelap (dark mode by default) dengan warna slate/navy gelap (#0B0F17, #111827) dan aksen biru langit (#0284C7 / #38BDF8) khas dashboard monitoring telekomunikasi profesional.

3. Semua teks antarmuka (UI Copy) menggunakan Bahasa Indonesia yang baku dan natural untuk teknisi FTTH/ISP (e.g. 'Status Perangkat', 'Latensi Rata-rata', 'Kehilangan Paket', 'Rute Hop', 'Jalankan Traceroute', 'Tambah Perangkat', 'Lokasi ODP/ODC').
4. Sediakan data benih (seed data) realistis perangkat FTTH di Indonesia (contoh: OLT ZTE C320 Pusat, GPON ONT Pelanggan ODP-KMY-01, Core MikroTik CCR2004, DNS Server 8.8.8.8 & 1.1.1.1).

5. Pastikan background ping loop di FastAPI aman (menggunakan `asyncio.create_subprocess_exec('ping', '-c', '1', '-W', '2', host)` atau tool fallback socket/async) dan visual traceroute tool menjalankan command `traceroute` sistem secara realtime/streaming atau response terstruktur.
6. Tambahkan data-testid di setiap komponen penting seperti `login-button`, `device-add-btn`, `run-traceroute-btn`, `device-table`, `latency-chart`, `refresh-interval-select`.
